title: VTG Swank Gold-Tone Tie Tack / Lapel Pin – Red Enamel Cross Fleur Design W/ Box
descriptionText:
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with only minor age-related wear. The enamel is vibrant, and the gold-tone finish remains bright. Includes the original Swank presentation box, which shows light age wear but is structurally sound.
💼 Description:
This elegant vintage Swank tie tack / lapel pin features a gold-tone metal base with a deep red enamel center design resembling a fleur-de-lis or Maltese cross motif. The pin embodies Swank’s mid-century craftsmanship and is perfect for collectors or those who appreciate refined men’s accessories.
Comes complete with its original Swank navy-blue display box with gold trim and blue velvet interior — ideal for display or gifting.
⚙️ Features:
Brand: Swank
Type: Men’s Tie Tack / Lapel Pin
Material: Gold-tone metal with red enamel
Design: Ornate cross / fleur-de-lis motif
Era: Likely 1960s–1970s
Attachment: Standard clutch back with chain and bar
Includes: Original Swank display box
💬 Notes:
Minimal surface wear from storage
Enamel intact and glossy
Perfect accessory for formal wear or vintage jewelry collection
